articles.summary: Reach has appointed Lieutenant General (Ret.) David A. Krumm, former Commander of the Alaska NORAD Region and Eleventh Air Force, to its Government Advisory Board, where he will help advance the company’s wireless power technology to meet critical public sector energy needs.
articles.title: Lt. Gen. (Ret.) David A. Krumm, Former Commander, Alaska NORAD Region Joins Reach’s Government Advisory Board
